title: A か B — “A or B”
summary: Joins two or more options and means one of them. Put か between nouns: A か B.

patterns.gloss: noun + か + noun (コーヒーか紅茶)

body.p: As in コーヒーか紅茶を飲みます, it means one of the two. The last か is normally dropped.
と means both (A and B); か means either one (A or B). The meaning is quite different.
The particle goes after the last noun: バスか電車で行きます.

examples.ja: コーヒーか紅茶（こうちゃ）を飲（の）みます。
ペンか鉛筆（えんぴつ）を使（つか）います。
examples.tr: I use a pen or a pencil.

examples.ja: バスか電車（でんしゃ）で行（い）きます。
examples.tr: I'll go by bus or train.

pitfalls: か is not “and.” For both, use と.
It looks like the question か but works differently.
